schemes.name: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program)
schemes.description: Provides monthly benefits on an EBT card to buy groceries for low-income households.

customer_care.notes: Dial 2-1-1 for local SNAP office referrals.

next_steps: Find your local SNAP office at fns.usda.gov/snap/apply
Receive EBT card within 30 days if approved
documents_needed: Photo ID (driver's license, passport, or state ID)
Proof of income (pay stubs, tax returns, employer letter)
Proof of residence (utility bill, lease, mortgage statement)
Social Security numbers for all household members
Proof of citizenship or immigration status
schemes.processing_time: 30 days (7 days expedited if income is extremely low)
schemes.benefit_amount: $234/month average per person (up to $1,751/month for family of 8)

schemes.name: WIC (Women, Infants, and Children)
schemes.description: Nutrition program providing healthy food, nutrition education, and breastfeeding support for pregnant women, new mothers, infants, and children under 5.

criteria.custom_rules: Must be pregnant, breastfeeding (up to 1 year), postpartum (up to 6 months), or have a child under 5. Applicants on Medicaid, SNAP, or TANF are automatically income-eligible.

customer_care.notes: Walk-ins often accepted at WIC clinics.

next_steps: Find your local WIC clinic at fns.usda.gov/wic
Schedule an appointment or walk in
Receive WIC card same day if eligible
documents_needed: Proof of identity (ID for you, birth certificate for child)
Proof of income (pay stubs, tax return, or benefit enrollment letter)
Proof of address (utility bill, lease, or mail with address)
Proof of pregnancy or child's birth certificate
schemes.benefit_amount: Monthly food packages worth $50-$75 + nutrition education

schemes.name: Medicaid
schemes.description: Free or low-cost comprehensive health coverage including doctor visits, hospital stays, prescriptions, preventive care, and mental health services.

criteria.custom_rules: Income limits vary by state. Expansion states cover adults up to 138% FPL. Pregnant women covered up to 200% FPL in many states.

customer_care.notes: TTY: 1-855-889-4325. Apply at Healthcare.gov or your state Medicaid website.

next_steps: Check your state's Medicaid website for specific income limits
Apply online at Healthcare.gov or state portal
Select a health plan and primary care provider
documents_needed: Proof of citizenship or lawful immigration status
Proof of income (pay stubs, W-2, tax return)
Proof of age (birth certificate or ID)

schemes.name: CHIP (Children's Health Insurance Program)
schemes.description: Low-cost health coverage for children and teens under 19 in families that earn too much for Medicaid but cannot afford private insurance.

criteria.custom_rules: Income limits vary by state, typically 200-300% FPL.

customer_care.notes: Call 1-877-KIDS-NOW to connect with your state's CHIP program.

next_steps: Call 1-877-KIDS-NOW to find your state's CHIP program
Apply online at Healthcare.gov or state portal
Provide children's info and family income
documents_needed: Proof of family income (pay stubs, W-2, tax return)
schemes.benefit_amount: Comprehensive health coverage; premiums $0-$50/month per family

schemes.name: TANF (Temporary Assistance for Needy Families)
schemes.description: Cash assistance and support services for low-income families with children. Helps cover rent, utilities, clothing, and personal items.

criteria.custom_rules: Work requirements apply. Time-limited (60 months lifetime). Pregnant women with no children may qualify.

customer_care.notes: Each state administers TANF differently. Dial 2-1-1 for local help.

documents_needed: Photo ID and Social Security cards for all household members
Proof of income (pay stubs or zero-income statement)
schemes.benefit_amount: Varies by state ($200-$700/month for family of 3)
schemes.benefit_type: Direct Deposit or EBT Cash Benefits

schemes.name: Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher
schemes.description: Rental assistance vouchers to help low-income families, elderly, and disabled afford housing. You pay ~30% of income, voucher covers the rest.

criteria.custom_rules: Based on Area Median Income. Priority for veterans, disabled, elderly, and families with children. Waitlists can be long.

customer_care.notes: Contact your local Public Housing Authority (PHA).

next_steps: Find your local PHA at hud.gov
Find approved housing within 60-120 days of receiving voucher
documents_needed: Photo ID for all adult household members
Social Security cards for all household members
schemes.benefit_amount: Pays portion of rent (you pay ~30% of income)

schemes.name: LIHEAP (Low Income Home Energy Assistance)
schemes.description: Helps low-income households pay heating and cooling bills. Provides one-time payments and crisis assistance for utility shutoffs.

customer_care.notes: Crisis assistance available if you have a shutoff notice.

next_steps: Provide utility bills and income proof
Receive payment directly to utility company
documents_needed: Proof of income for all household members

schemes.name: Federal Pell Grant
schemes.description: Federal grant for undergraduate students with financial need. Unlike loans, grants do not have to be repaid. Covers tuition, fees, room, and board.

criteria.custom_rules: Based on Student Aid Index from FAFSA. Must be undergraduate. No prior bachelor's degree. Can apply while planning to enroll.

customer_care.notes: Create an FSA ID at studentaid.gov first. FAFSA opens October 1 each year.

next_steps: Create an FSA ID at studentaid.gov
List schools you are interested in
Accept the grant through your school
documents_needed: Federal tax returns (yours and parents' if dependent)
W-2 forms and other income records
schemes.benefit_type: Applied to tuition or refunded to student

schemes.name: Child Care Subsidies (CCDF)
schemes.description: Helps low-income families afford childcare while parents work, attend school, or participate in job training.

criteria.custom_rules: Must be working, in school, or in job training. Income limits vary by state. Children with disabilities may qualify up to age 19.

customer_care.notes: Dial 2-1-1 for local childcare resource and referral.

documents_needed: Photo ID and Social Security cards
Proof of employment, school enrollment, or job training
schemes.benefit_amount: Covers 75-100% of childcare costs depending on income

schemes.name: WIOA Job Training
schemes.description: Free job training, career counseling, and employment services for unemployed and underemployed adults through American Job Centers.

criteria.custom_rules: Priority for public assistance recipients and low-income individuals. Veterans receive priority of service.

customer_care.notes: Find your local American Job Center at careeronestop.org.

next_steps: Find your local American Job Center
Work with career counselor on a plan
Complete training and get job placement help

schemes.name: SBA Women's Business Programs
schemes.description: Small Business Administration programs for women entrepreneurs including grants, loans, mentoring, and federal contracting opportunities.

criteria.custom_rules: Open to all women interested in starting or growing a small business. Free counseling through Women's Business Centers.

customer_care.notes: Find your local Women's Business Center at sba.gov/local-assistance.

next_steps: Find your local Women's Business Center
Develop a business plan with SBA mentor
schemes.benefit_amount: Free counseling + access to grants and low-interest loans

schemes.name: Lifeline Phone/Internet Discount
schemes.description: FCC program providing a monthly discount on phone or internet service for low-income households.

criteria.custom_rules: Automatically eligible if on Medicaid, SNAP, SSI, Federal Public Housing, Veterans Pension, or Tribal programs.

customer_care.notes: Apply online or through your phone/internet provider.

next_steps: Apply online or through your provider
Provide proof of enrollment or income
documents_needed: Proof of program enrollment (SNAP, Medicaid, SSI letter) OR proof of income

schemes.name: Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC)
schemes.description: Tax credit for low-to-moderate income workers. Reduces taxes owed and may result in a refund even if you owe no taxes.

criteria.custom_rules: Must have earned income. Limits: ~$59,000 with 3+ children, ~$17,640 with no children. Investment income must be below $11,000.

customer_care.notes: Free tax filing help at VITA sites: irs.gov/vita

next_steps: Use IRS EITC Assistant tool to check eligibility
File federal tax return claiming EITC
Find free tax help at a VITA site
Receive refund within 21 days of e-filing
documents_needed: Social Security cards for you, spouse, and children
Birth dates for all household members
Bank account info for direct deposit

schemes.name: Supplemental Security Income (SSI)
schemes.description: Monthly cash payments for people with disabilities, blind individuals, and seniors (65+) with very limited income and resources.

criteria.custom_rules: Must be disabled, blind, or age 65+. Resource limit $2,000 individual / $3,000 couple.

customer_care.notes: TTY: 1-800-325-0778. Apply at local Social Security office.

documents_needed: Birth certificate or proof of age
Medical records and doctor contact info
Proof of citizenship or immigration status

schemes.name: Head Start / Early Head Start
schemes.description: Free early childhood education, health, nutrition, and family support services for children birth to age 5 and pregnant women.

criteria.custom_rules: Priority for families below 100% FPL, homeless families, foster children, and those on public assistance. Early Head Start serves pregnant women and children 0-3.

customer_care.notes: Find a program near you at eclkc.ohs.acf.hhs.gov/center-locator

next_steps: Find a Head Start program near you
Contact the program to check availability
Provide health and developmental screening records
schemes.processing_time: Enrollment typically seasonal (fall) but some accept year-round
schemes.benefit_amount: Free preschool + meals + health screenings + family services

schemes.name: Free School Meals (Lunch & Breakfast)
schemes.description: Free or reduced-price breakfast and lunch for children at school. Available at most public schools.

criteria.custom_rules: Free meals at 130% FPL or below. Reduced-price at 131-185% FPL. SNAP/TANF/Head Start households auto-qualify.

customer_care.notes: One application per household covers all children in the school.

documents_needed: Income info for all household members
SNAP/TANF case number (if applicable — auto approval)
Last 4 digits of SSN of adult signer
schemes.benefit_amount: Free breakfast and lunch daily during school year

schemes.name: HUD-VASH (Veterans Housing)
schemes.description: Housing vouchers combined with VA supportive services for homeless veterans.

criteria.custom_rules: Must be a homeless veteran or at imminent risk. Priority for chronically homeless.

customer_care.notes: Veterans Crisis Line: 988 (press 1).

next_steps: Call the VA Homeless Veterans Hotline
Visit your local VA Medical Center
Receive housing voucher and case management
Find approved housing with VA assistance

schemes.name: VA Health Care
schemes.description: Comprehensive health care for eligible veterans including primary care, specialty care, mental health, and prescriptions.

criteria.custom_rules: Based on veteran status, service-connected disabilities, and income. Most veterans who served honorably are eligible.

customer_care.notes: Apply online, by phone, or at any VA medical center. Veterans Crisis Line: 988 (press 1).

next_steps: Or visit nearest VA medical center

schemes.name: Domestic Violence Support Services (FVPSA)
schemes.description: Emergency shelter, crisis hotline, counseling, and legal advocacy for domestic violence survivors. All services are free and confidential.

criteria.custom_rules: Available to ALL DV survivors regardless of income, citizenship, or immigration status.

customer_care.notes: Text START to 88788. Chat at thehotline.org. All services confidential. TTY: 1-800-787-3224.

next_steps: A trained advocate will help create a safety plan
Get connected to local shelter and services
documents_needed: No documents required for emergency services
Legal documents for protective orders (helpful but not required)
schemes.benefit_amount: Free emergency shelter + counseling + legal advocacy

schemes.name: Medicaid for Pregnant Women
schemes.description: Extended Medicaid with higher income limits for pregnant women. Covers prenatal care, delivery, and 12 months postpartum.

criteria.custom_rules: Higher income limits than regular Medicaid (185-200% FPL). Many states cover immigrants. Postpartum coverage extended to 12 months.

customer_care.notes: Presumptive eligibility may provide immediate temporary coverage.

next_steps: Apply at Healthcare.gov or state Medicaid portal
Provide proof of pregnancy from doctor
schemes.processing_time: Expedited — often same day presumptive eligibility
schemes.benefit_amount: Full coverage: prenatal, delivery, 12 months postpartum

schemes.name: Emergency Rental Assistance
schemes.description: Helps renters behind on rent or at risk of eviction. Covers past-due rent, future rent, and utility arrears.

criteria.custom_rules: Must be a renter at risk of eviction. Priority for very low income and unemployed 90+ days.

customer_care.notes: Programs administered locally. Dial 2-1-1 to find your program.

next_steps: Dial 2-1-1 for local emergency rental program
Provide proof of hardship and income
Payments go directly to landlord/utility company
documents_needed: Proof of income loss or hardship
schemes.benefit_amount: Up to 12-18 months of rent and utility assistance

schemes.name: Weatherization Assistance Program
schemes.description: Free home energy efficiency improvements including insulation, air sealing, and heating/cooling system repair.

criteria.custom_rules: Priority for elderly (60+), disabled, and families with young children. Auto-eligible if on SSI, SNAP, or TANF.

customer_care.notes: Contact your state agency or dial 2-1-1.

documents_needed: Proof of income or public assistance enrollment
Proof of homeownership or landlord approval
schemes.processing_time: Varies; work completed in 1-2 weeks once selected

schemes.name: Texas SNAP (Lone Star Card)
schemes.description: Texas food assistance via the Lone Star Card. Apply at YourTexasBenefits.com.

criteria.custom_rules: Texas BBCE with 165% FPL gross income limit. Net income at or below 100% FPL.

customer_care.notes: Apply for SNAP, Medicaid, and TANF at once.

schemes.name: Texas Medicaid
schemes.description: Texas Medicaid for children, pregnant women, elderly, and disabled. Texas has not expanded Medicaid to all adults.

criteria.custom_rules: Texas has NOT expanded Medicaid. Children up to 200% FPL. Pregnant women up to 198% FPL.

customer_care.notes: Apply at YourTexasBenefits.com.

schemes.name: Texas CHIP
schemes.description: Health insurance for Texas children under 19 whose families earn too much for Medicaid.

customer_care.notes: Apply at YourTexasBenefits.com.

schemes.name: Texas TANF
schemes.description: Texas cash assistance for very low-income families with children.

criteria.custom_rules: Very strict. 12-month limit for single parents.

customer_care.notes: Shorter time limits than federal max.

schemes.benefit_amount: $208/month for family of 2, $284/month for family of 3

schemes.name: Texas Workforce Childcare Services
schemes.description: Subsidized childcare for working and student Texas families.

criteria.custom_rules: Must be working, in training, or in school.

customer_care.notes: Contact local Workforce Solutions.

schemes.name: Harris County Childcare Assistance
schemes.description: Additional childcare support for Harris County residents.

customer_care.notes: Contact Harris County Social Services.

schemes.name: CalFresh (California SNAP)
schemes.description: California's food assistance with expanded eligibility including some college students.

criteria.custom_rules: CA BBCE at 200% FPL.

customer_care.notes: Fastest at GetCalFresh.org.

schemes.name: Medi-Cal (California Medicaid)
schemes.description: California's Medicaid — covers all income-eligible adults regardless of immigration status.

criteria.custom_rules: Covers undocumented adults. Pregnant women up to 213% FPL.

customer_care.notes: Apply at CoveredCA.com.

schemes.benefit_amount: Free comprehensive health, dental, and vision

schemes.name: CalWORKs (California TANF)
schemes.description: California cash aid for families with children, plus employment services and childcare.

criteria.custom_rules: Pregnant women may qualify. 48-month time limit.

customer_care.notes: Apply at BenefitsCal.com.

schemes.name: Massachusetts SNAP (DTA)
schemes.description: Massachusetts food assistance with expanded eligibility at 200% FPL.

customer_care.notes: Apply at DTAConnect.com.

schemes.name: MassHealth (Massachusetts Medicaid)
schemes.description: Massachusetts comprehensive health coverage — one of the most generous Medicaid programs in the US.

criteria.custom_rules: MA expanded Medicaid. Children up to 300% FPL, pregnant women up to 200% FPL.

customer_care.notes: Apply at MAhealthconnector.org.

schemes.name: New York SNAP
schemes.description: New York food assistance with expanded eligibility. Apply at myBenefits.ny.gov.

customer_care.notes: Apply for SNAP, Medicaid, and TANF.

schemes.name: New York Medicaid
schemes.description: New York's expanded Medicaid with comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.

criteria.custom_rules: NY expanded Medicaid. Children up to 400% FPL, pregnant women up to 223% FPL.

customer_care.notes: Includes dental and vision.

schemes.name: Florida SNAP (ACCESS Florida)
schemes.description: Florida food assistance via ACCESS Florida portal.

customer_care.notes: Apply at MyACCESSFlorida.com.

schemes.name: Florida Medicaid
schemes.description: Florida Medicaid for children, pregnant women, elderly, and disabled. Florida has not expanded Medicaid.

criteria.custom_rules: Not expanded. Children up to 210% FPL. Pregnant women up to 191% FPL.

customer_care.notes: Apply through ACCESS Florida.

schemes.name: Medicare Savings Programs
schemes.description: Helps pay Medicare premiums, deductibles, and coinsurance for low-income seniors and disabled Medicare beneficiaries.

criteria.custom_rules: Must be enrolled in Medicare Part A. QMB covers premiums, deductibles, copays at 100% FPL. SLMB at 120% FPL. QI at 135% FPL.

customer_care.notes: TTY: 1-877-486-2048. Contact your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) for free counseling.

next_steps: Benefits begin the month after approval
schemes.benefit_amount: Pays Medicare Part B premium (74.70/month in 2024) + may cover deductibles and copays

schemes.name: SNAP for Seniors (60+)
schemes.description: Simplified SNAP application for seniors 60 and older with streamlined verification and higher deductions for medical expenses.

criteria.custom_rules: For adults 60+. Simplified application. Medical expense deductions above $35/month. May qualify even with higher income due to deductions.

customer_care.notes: Many seniors qualify but do not apply. Dial 2-1-1 for help with your application.

next_steps: Contact your local SNAP office or dial 2-1-1
Provide income and medical expense information
schemes.benefit_amount: $234/month average; seniors may get extra due to medical deductions

schemes.name: Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI)
schemes.description: Monthly disability benefits for workers who have paid into Social Security and can no longer work due to a medical condition expected to last at least 12 months.

criteria.custom_rules: Must have worked and paid Social Security taxes. Must have a qualifying disability preventing substantial gainful activity. No income limit — based on work credits.

customer_care.notes: TTY: 1-800-325-0778. Apply online, by phone, or at local Social Security office.

schemes.name: Child Tax Credit
schemes.description: Tax credit of up to $2,000 per qualifying child under 17. Partially refundable — you can get up to $1,700 back even if you owe no taxes.

criteria.custom_rules: Full credit for income under $200,000 (single) or $400,000 (married). Phases out above those amounts. Child must have SSN.

customer_care.notes: Claim when filing taxes. Free filing at VITA sites.

next_steps: Claim Child Tax Credit on tax form
Find free tax help at irs.gov/vita
Receive credit as part of tax refund
schemes.benefit_amount: Up to $2,000 per child under 17 ($1,700 refundable)

schemes.name: ACA Marketplace Health Insurance (Subsidized)
schemes.description: Subsidized health insurance through the ACA marketplace (Healthcare.gov). Premium tax credits and cost-sharing reductions for those who earn too much for Medicaid.

criteria.custom_rules: For those earning 100-400% FPL who do not qualify for Medicaid. Enhanced subsidies currently have no upper income limit through 2025. Cannot be offered affordable employer coverage.

customer_care.notes: Open enrollment Nov 1 - Jan 15 annually. Special enrollment for life changes (job loss, baby, moving).

next_steps: Create an account and complete application
Select a plan and pay first premium
Use your new coverage starting the 1st of the month
schemes.processing_time: Instant eligibility determination; coverage starts 1st of next month
schemes.benefit_amount: Premium tax credits can reduce monthly premium to $0-$50 for low income

schemes.name: IRS Free File & VITA Tax Preparation
schemes.description: Free tax preparation and filing for households earning under $79,000. VITA sites offer in-person help; IRS Free File provides free software online.

criteria.custom_rules: IRS Free File for income under $79,000. VITA sites for income under $64,000, disabled, limited English, or elderly. AARP Tax-Aide for 50+.

customer_care.notes: Find a VITA site at irs.gov/vita or call 1-800-906-9887.

next_steps: Find a VITA site near you at irs.gov/vita
Or use IRS Free File at irs.gov/freefile
Bring all tax documents to your appointment
Have taxes prepared and filed for free
documents_needed: Social Security cards for all family members
schemes.processing_time: Same day preparation at VITA; refund in 21 days
schemes.benefit_amount: Saves $200-$400 in tax preparation fees + ensures you claim all credits

schemes.name: Federal Student Aid (FAFSA - All Types)
schemes.description: Complete the FAFSA to access federal grants, work-study, and student loans. Even if you think your income is too high, many families qualify for some aid.

criteria.custom_rules: No income limit for federal student loans. Grants based on financial need. All students planning to attend college should complete FAFSA. Available for undergraduate and graduate students.

customer_care.notes: FAFSA opens October 1 each year. Apply as early as possible for best aid.

next_steps: List colleges you plan to attend
Compare financial aid offers from schools
schemes.processing_time: 3-5 days for FAFSA; schools respond in weeks
schemes.benefit_amount: Grants up to $7,395/year; loans up to $12,500/year; work-study varies

schemes.name: SNAP Employment & Training (SNAP E&T)
schemes.description: Free job training, education, and work experience programs for SNAP recipients. Includes GED classes, vocational training, job search help, and transportation assistance.

criteria.custom_rules: Must be a current SNAP recipient. Voluntary in most states. May cover transportation, childcare, and other costs while in training.

customer_care.notes: Ask your SNAP caseworker about E&T programs in your area.

schemes.benefit_amount: Free training + may cover transportation, childcare, books, and supplies
